headline:
Congress threw out
both housing decrees.
sub: Five things Costa del Sol agents should know this week.
items: The automatic two-year tenancy extension and the cap on rent updates fell with Friday's vote — the old rules are back.
Andalusian resale asking prices hit a record €2,952/m², up 10% in a year; Málaga is the priciest province at €4,317/m².
Málaga province rents set another record in September at €18.8/m²; Marbella and Ojén are both over €23/m².
Foreign buyers paid €2,479/m² against €1,839 for Spanish buyers — around 35% more.
Buying in Málaga city now takes 54.5% of household disposable income, against 36.9% nationally.
